title: Complex Counterfactual Conditionals: ha... akkor... volna

sections.title: Hypothetical Scenarios in Historical Analysis
sections.content: In analyzing historical turning points, use *ha + past + volna*, followed by *akkor + past + volna*: *Ha a kurucok fegyelmezettebbek lettek volna, akkor megnyerték volna a trencséni csatát.* ('If the Kurucs had been more disciplined, they would have won the battle of Trencsén.').

items.spanish: Ha Franciaország több pénzt küldött volna, a szabadságharc tovább tartott volna.
items.english: If France had sent more funds, the war of independence would have lasted longer.

items.spanish: A jobbágyok nem harcoltak volna, ha nem bíztak volna a fejedelemben.
items.english: The serfs would not have fought if they had not trusted the prince.
